desc:
Start an AI company in your bedroom and grow it into a giant tech campus.

Use Code: UPDATE
Next Code at 500 Likes

💻 Train your own AI on your laptop. Pick its size, its data and its personality, then see how it scores.
🚀 Launch it and watch people try it. A good model brings thousands of new users, a great one goes viral.
🖥️ Buy GPUs, fill your server, and train bigger models faster.
👥 Hire engineers, researchers and marketers, and keep your team happy.
🏢 Move from your bedroom to a co-working space, an office, an HQ, a tower and finally your own campus.
🛋️ Furnish every office the way you want it.
📈 Take on big contracts, handle crises, beat rival AI labs, and build your own AI chip.
💰 Your AI keeps earning while you're offline.
🏆 Sell your company for billions and start again, stronger.

Visit other players' offices and leave a like on the ones you like.
